aiResearchSummary.text: Inito is researching and developing a slab-based optical device designed to capture high-resolution images of diagnostic test strips. This device utilizes two illumination devices and corresponding slabs to direct light onto the test strip, reducing light scattering and enhancing image quality. Additionally, Inito is working on a system and apparatus for determining body parameters and microbial load, which includes a two-dimensional surface with delivery media for sample transfer and strips to hold these media. These innovations focus on improving diagnostic accuracy and efficiency in medical testing.
